# OntoLogos v0.3.1

Patch release: documentation corrections, `Reasoner::classify` delegate hint, and `classify` CLI inference reports.

## Install (Rust)

```toml
[dependencies]
ontologos-core = "0.3.1"
ontologos-parser = "0.3.1"
ontologos-profile = "0.3.1"
ontologos-rdfs = "0.3.1"
```

Docs:

- https://docs.rs/ontologos-core/0.3.1
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-parser/0.3.1
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-profile/0.3.1
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-rdfs/0.3.1

## What changed in v0.3.1

- **`ontologos classify`** — emits the same inference report as `materialize` (`status: classified`)
- **`Reasoner::classify()`** — `Profile::Rdfs` returns a clear delegate hint (use `ontologos_rdfs::classify_reasoner`)
- **Docs** — Pizza profile detection (DL), OWL imports not resolved, RDFS scope limits

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos.git
cd ontologos
./benchmarks/scripts/download.sh
cargo build -p ontologos-cli --release
./target/release/ontologos classify benchmarks/data/family.owl
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos/blob/v0.3.1/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of changes.
